name: Kirtland AFB
description: Kirtland AFB hosts the 377th Air Base Wing, Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center, and specialized research and test missions across nuclear deterrence, directed energy, and space operations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Truman Gate (Main Gate)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate with Visitor Control Center. After-hours visitor passes processed here.
gates.address: Truman St SE, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117

gates.name: Truman Gate Visitor Control Center (VCC)
gates.notes: Day passes, visitor registration, and after-hours unofficial visitor passes. REAL ID required. Phone: 505-846-7509.
gates.address: Truman St SE, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117

gates.name: Gibson Gate
gates.notes: Daily access with weekend/holiday hours. Phone: 505-846-7240.
gates.address: Gibson Blvd SE, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117

gates.name: Wyoming Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0530-1900; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.address: Wyoming Blvd SE, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117

gates.name: Carlisle Gate
gates.notes: Limited weekday access. Closed weekends and federal holidays.

gates.name: Kirtland Contractor Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0530-1300; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Commercial traffic arriving outside these hours must use Truman Gate for searching. Mission-critical personnel use this gate during emergencies.

resources.name: Thunderbird Inn Dining Facility (DFAC)
resources.description: Primary DFAC with specialty bars (wings, tacos, pasta, stir fry). Retirees authorized weekends/holidays 0900-1300.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Bfast 0600-0800, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1600-1900; Sat-Sun/Holidays: Brunch 0900-1300, Dinner 1700-1900; Midnight Grab & Go daily 2200-0000
resources.address: Bldg 20350, 1551 1st St SE, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117

resources.name: Thunderbird Inn Flight Kitchen
resources.description: 24/7 flight meal ordering for aircrew and mission personnel.

resources.name: Kirtland Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, food court, and services.
resources.address: 7901 Gibson Blvd SE, Bldg 20176, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117

resources.name: Kirtland AFB Commissary
resources.description: Defense Commissary Agency full-service grocery with bakery, deli, rotisserie, and sushi.
resources.address: 7801 Gibson Blvd SE, Bldg 20180, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117

resources.name: Sandia Area Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union on base with drive-thru and 24/7 ATM.
resources.address: 1850 Wyoming Blvd SE, Bldg 20600, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117

resources.name: Kirtland Federal Credit Union
resources.description: Credit union serving Kirtland AFB and local community members.

resources.name: 377th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care clinic and TRICARE services. No emergency department on base — dial 911 or use UNM Hospital.
resources.address: 1501 San Pedro Dr SE, Bldg 47, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117

resources.name: East Side Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness center with 5 weight rooms, cardio, racquetball, basketball, boxing, and outdoor track. No 24/7 access.

resources.name: West Side Fitness Center
resources.description: Secondary fitness facility with 24/7 CAC access for authorized patrons.
resources.hours: Staffed Mon-Fri 0600-1800; 24/7 CAC access for registered patrons

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service.

resources.name: Military Personnel Flight (MPF)
resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, promotions, and personnel actions. Use RAPIDS for appointments.

resources.name: 377th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: MWR, dining, fitness, recreation, lodging, and family programs.
resources.hours: Facility hours listed on FSS website

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, and monthly newcomers orientation at Mountain View Club.
resources.address: Bldg 20245, Consolidated Support Facility, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117

resources.name: Housing Office (MHO)
resources.description: On-base privatized housing referrals and off-base housing assistance.

resources.name: Roadrunner Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging with 24/7 front desk for PCS and TDY arrivals.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100

resources.name: Tijeras Arroyo Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with Coyote Grill lunch service.

resources.name: Kirtland Lanes Bowling Center
resources.description: Bowling center with Sparetime Grill snack bar.

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (The CORE)
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, Boulder Lab climbing wall, and recreational programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0900-1730, Sat 0900-1300; closed Sun and holidays

resources.name: Visitor Control Center (Truman Gate)
resources.description: Visitor passes, DBIDS vetting, and base access. REAL ID required. Staffed 24/7.
resources.address: Truman St SE, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117

events.title: TEAM Kirtland Newcomers Orientation
events.description: Monthly orientation and information fair for incoming personnel and spouses. Register through your CSS.

primaryAction.title: Truman Gate Visitor Control Center
primaryAction.address: Truman St SE, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. After-hours arrivals contact Truman Gate VCC (505-846-7509) or Roadrunner Inn (505-846-9653).

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Office before arrival. Roadrunner Inn provides temporary lodging. On-base family housing managed through AF Housing portal.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC at 505-846-5999 if no sponsor is assigned 45 days before arrival.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource for relocation support.
